parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, border/document targeting, or documented visitor violence; hate-crime law covering gender identity since 2018/19 and generally functioning institutions provide some recourse, though hate-speech enforcement is contested. Resident LGR medical conditions and narrowed youth care are not deducted for a visitor. The main traveller-facing exposure is the documented national swimming-pool chain ban on choosing changing rooms, reaching ordinary public facilities with legal contestation but no documented effective remedy. That is a real universal-style facility exposure, but scoped to pools rather than all public buildings, custody or emergency care, with no organised targeting. Organised opposition is a climate negative without documented visitor-facing escalation.
